headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Front-Line Shifts
war_summary: The latest returns show Weathered Expanse still the chief storm centre, with 100 strategic-base events in 24 hours and 13 in the latest two-hour window. Its line now stands at one Warden, four Colonial, and four neutral bases, a change from the previous edition’s five Colonial and three neutral positions. Mooring County remains fiercely contested at eight Warden and four Colonial bases, with 54 daily events and one in the newest window; its balance has shifted from three Colonial and one neutral base. Stlican Shelf has also altered, now holding one Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral position after 11 daily events, including two recently. The casualty tempo in these sectors is costly, though the one-hour figures are generally below the preceding hour. Marban Hollow remains divided at one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base, with no fresh event in the latest two hours. Callahan’s Passage retains all ten Warden bases despite 16 daily events, while Nevish Line remains at seven Warden and one Colonial after nine daily events. Stonecradle shows accelerating casualties and enlistments but no recorded base movement.
